verdict.rationale: Ghostty ships an official CLI. Every config key works as a command-line flag (ghostty-docs-37), and a hands-on probe confirms a `+action` surface such as `ghostty +list-actions` and `ghostty +help` (ghostty-probe-rt-1). The same probe found no remote-control or IPC interface, so an agent or script cannot drive or read a running instance from the CLI, which limits its use for agentic workflows. Missing for 10: CLI commands to control a running instance, CLI access to terminal output, agent-oriented CLI documentation, and independent corroboration of CLI workflows.
